desc.zh: 保留可达的前缀边界，排除整词自匹配。
desc.en: Keep reachable prefix boundaries and exclude a whole-word self-match.

complexity: O(S + sum(len(w)^3)) expected time; O(N + L) auxiliary space

concepts.name: Prefix reachability
concepts.description: Merge cut histories that reach the same prefix boundary.

concepts.name: Exclude self-match
concepts.description: Forbid the edge from 0 to n so a witness uses at least two shorter words.
